column1: # JasprNether block emulation table -- the ONE place where BetterNether / NetherEx blocks become vanilla 1.12 blocks.
# Structure templates keep the mod block ids; world generation and mechanics resolve every mod block through this file.
# To use genuine custom blocks later, change the vanilla column (and meta) here only.
# source        mod block id (betternether:* or netherex:*)
# meta          mod meta: * = any, or a number. Shaped blocks use the vanilla-shape encoding of the same family
#               (stairs/doors/gates/ladders/slabs as vanilla: slab bottom 0 / top 8; facing 2-5 north/south/west/east;
# vanilla       vanilla 1.12 block name, or "void" = place nothing (keep the world block).
# vanilla_meta  number, "=" = same as the mod meta, "+N" = mod meta plus N.
# role          structure (template decoration), worldgen (generated terrain/flora), mechanic (a plugin rule keys on it),
#               player (only placed by players from a JasprNether item).
# Pop-proof rule: stand-ins never need soil a physics update could remove (no grass, cactus, sugar cane, saplings, vines).
